theme.title: Rotation: Growth → Value & Defensives
theme.summary: Energy (+0.97%) and Consumer Discretionary (+0.83%) led the market today, while Technology (-3.38%) and Communication Svcs (-1.28%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -1.28% versus +0.39% for defensives and -0.35% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained -0.96% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -3.19%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -2.03%. The VIX rose 22.55% to 21.09, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 2.60% to $3,899.80, crude oil was little changed at $104.58, and bitcoin slipped 0.91% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
